text:
Maya (partnerships): Heads up — Kestrel Systems wants early access to preview their new accelerator and list a marketplace tile. Need to align NDA timing, perf benchmarks, and joint announcement gating. Quick sync?
Oliver (legal): I can take NDA review. Do we have their latest redlines? If not, ask them to send.
Maya (partnerships): They emailed redlines last week. I forwarded to legal. We asked to use our standard EAP NDA + data-sharing addendum. @Priya can you confirm preferred announcement window?
Priya (pm): Prefer 2-week buffer after perf pass. Kestrel proposed a co-blog in the week of Jul 14 — push public marketplace tile target to Jul 28 to be safe.
Zane (eng): For perf we need hardware access, bench scripts, and sample models. Proposal: run Llama-2-13b, MPT-7B, and a small internal Redwood test model to get latency/cost baselines. Also need telemetry hooks (power, NVMe). Can Kestrel share power traces?
Ravi (cloud-partners): For marketplace we need a container image + helm chart and a Quickstart manifest that creates required VPC endpoints. We can reuse marketplace-sdk v2 and the provisioning template.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: @Oliver — NDA sign-off by Tue; @Zane — perf smoke tests by Thu; @Ravi — marketplace artifact checklist; @Priya — coordinate co-blog draft. Weekly sync Fridays 10am. Sounds good?
Oliver (legal): On it. If their redlines try to restrict telemetry sharing or add broad IP claims, we'll push back. ETA Tue EOD.
Zane (eng): Can we get a 2-day slot in Kestrel's lab next week for on-device runs? Also need an anonymized sample dataset for latency/batch tests.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Fri 10:00am — Kestrel preview sync (Maya, Zane, Priya, Oliver, Ravi)
Maya (partnerships): Sam at Kestrel confirmed lab availability Tue-Wed next week and will send access creds after NDA.
Priya (pm): Draft co-blog outline: problem statement, joint perf highlights, how to deploy via marketplace quickstart, and customer story placeholder. I'll drop a draft in #partnerships-drafts by Wed.
Zane (eng): Bench runner snippet for them to use: `./run_bench --model llama-2-13b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --metric latency --out perf.json` — ask them to return perf.json + system logs.
Maya (partnerships): Note gating: public announcement waits 48h after we verify no regressions on safety/eval tests and legal sign-off on quotes. Add to checklist.
Oliver (legal): Also need explicit written permission to use Kestrel logo and to quote numbers. Put that in the NDA addendum.
Maya (partnerships): :thumbsup: I'll update the shared tracker (https://redwood.example.com/partnerships/kestrel-preview) and ping the group when NDA is green.
Priya (pm): One more ask from Kestrel: they want a soft marketplace listing (internal-only) before public tile — can we support staging listings?
Ravi (cloud-partners): Yes, we have a staging marketplace namespace. We'll document the steps and a minimal helm chart template.
Zane (eng): If staging is set up, we can run continuous perf tests and automatically upload perf.json to the shared bucket for review.
Maya (partnerships): Great — I'll confirm staging flow with Sam and close the NDA loop. Meeting follow-ups will be in the tracker. Thanks everyone.
